SELECT p.span_name caller_operation,c.span_name callee_operation,count(*) n,
                median(c.duration)/1e6 median_ms,median(p.duration)/1e6 caller_ms,
                count(*) FILTER (WHERE coalesce((c."attr.status_code" IN ('Error','STATUS_CODE_ERROR') OR c."attr.http.response.status_code" >= 500),false) AND coalesce((p."attr.status_code" IN ('Error','STATUS_CODE_ERROR') OR p."attr.http.response.status_code" >= 500),false)
                  AND p.time<=c.time AND epoch_ns(p.time)::HUGEINT+p.duration>=epoch_ns(c.time)::HUGEINT+c.duration) linked_errors,
                count(*) FILTER (WHERE p.time<=c.time AND epoch_ns(p.time)::HUGEINT+p.duration>=epoch_ns(c.time)::HUGEINT+c.duration
                  AND c.duration>=p.duration*.5 AND c.duration>=20000000) dominant_calls,
                min(c.time) first_time,max(c.time) last_time
                FROM normal_traces p JOIN normal_traces c ON p.trace_id=c.trace_id AND p.span_id=c.parent_span_id
                WHERE p.service_name='ts-seat-service' AND c.service_name='ts-order-other-service'
                  AND lower(p."attr.span_kind") IN ('server', 'span_kind_server') AND lower(c."attr.span_kind") IN ('server', 'span_kind_server')
                GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

WITH bindings AS (
                SELECT p.trace_id,p.span_id,p.parent_span_id,p.time,p.duration,p.span_name,
                  coalesce((p."attr.status_code" IN ('Error','STATUS_CODE_ERROR') OR p."attr.http.response.status_code" >= 500),false) is_error,
                  list_distinct(flatten(list(regexp_extract_all(l.message,'https?://([a-zA-Z0-9_-]+)(?:[.:/]|$)',1)))) hosts
                FROM normal_traces p JOIN normal_logs l ON l.trace_id=p.trace_id AND l.span_id=p.span_id
                  AND l.service_name=p.service_name AND l.time>=p.time
                  AND epoch_ns(l.time)::HUGEINT <= epoch_ns(p.time)::HUGEINT+p.duration
                WHERE p.service_name='ts-ui-dashboard' AND lower(p."attr.span_kind") IN ('client', 'span_kind_client')
                  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM normal_traces c WHERE c.trace_id=p.trace_id AND c.parent_span_id=p.span_id AND lower(c."attr.span_kind") IN ('server', 'span_kind_server'))
                GROUP BY p.trace_id,p.span_id,p.parent_span_id,p.time,p.duration,p.span_name,p."attr.status_code",p."attr.http.response.status_code"
              ) SELECT b.span_name client_operation,count(*) n,count(*) FILTER (WHERE b.is_error) errors,
                  count(*) FILTER (WHERE b.is_error AND coalesce((a."attr.status_code" IN ('Error','STATUS_CODE_ERROR') OR a."attr.http.response.status_code" >= 500),false) AND a.time<=b.time
                    AND epoch_ns(a.time)::HUGEINT+a.duration >= epoch_ns(b.time)::HUGEINT+b.duration) linked_errors,
                  median(b.duration)/1e6 median_ms,min(b.time) first_time,max(b.time) last_time
                FROM bindings b LEFT JOIN normal_traces a ON a.trace_id=b.trace_id AND a.span_id=b.parent_span_id
                  AND a.service_name='ts-ui-dashboard' AND lower(a."attr.span_kind") IN ('server', 'span_kind_server')
                WHERE len(b.hosts)=1 AND b.hosts[1]='ts-order-other-service' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

purpose: exact CLIENT/SERVER binding and nearest same-service caller SERVER ancestor
sql:
WITH RECURSIVE ancestry AS (
                  SELECT p.trace_id,p.span_id origin,p.parent_span_id next_id,[p.span_id] visited
                  FROM abnormal_traces p WHERE p.service_name='ts-ui-dashboard' AND lower(p."attr.span_kind") IN ('client', 'span_kind_client')
                  UNION ALL
                  SELECT x.trace_id,x.origin,a.parent_span_id,list_append(x.visited,a.span_id)
                  FROM ancestry x JOIN abnormal_traces a ON a.trace_id=x.trace_id AND a.span_id=x.next_id
                  WHERE a.service_name='ts-ui-dashboard' AND NOT lower(a."attr.span_kind") IN ('server', 'span_kind_server')
                    AND NOT list_contains(x.visited,a.span_id)
                ), caller_servers AS (
                  SELECT x.origin,a.* FROM ancestry x JOIN abnormal_traces a
                    ON a.trace_id=x.trace_id AND a.span_id=x.next_id
                  WHERE a.service_name='ts-ui-dashboard' AND lower(a."attr.span_kind") IN ('server', 'span_kind_server')
                ), pairs AS (
                  SELECT p.trace_id,p.span_id,p.parent_span_id,p.time,p.duration,
                    p.span_name client_operation,c.span_name server_operation,
                    p."attr.http.request.method" client_method,c."attr.http.request.method" server_method,
                    p.duration/1e6 client_ms,c.duration/1e6 server_ms,
                    (cast(p.duration AS DOUBLE)-cast(c.duration AS DOUBLE))/1e6 wait_ms,
                    coalesce((p."attr.status_code" IN ('Error','STATUS_CODE_ERROR') OR p."attr.http.response.status_code" >= 500),false) client_error,coalesce((c."attr.status_code" IN ('Error','STATUS_CODE_ERROR') OR c."attr.http.response.status_code" >= 500),false) server_error,
                    c.time >= p.time AND epoch_ns(c.time)::HUGEINT + c.duration <= epoch_ns(p.time)::HUGEINT + p.duration contained
                  FROM abnormal_traces p JOIN abnormal_traces c ON p.trace_id=c.trace_id AND p.span_id=c.parent_span_id
                  WHERE p.service_name='ts-ui-dashboard' AND c.service_name='ts-travel-plan-service'
                    AND lower(p."attr.span_kind") IN ('client', 'span_kind_client') AND lower(c."attr.span_kind") IN ('server', 'span_kind_server')
                ), observed AS (
                  SELECT p.*,coalesce(coalesce((a."attr.status_code" IN ('Error','STATUS_CODE_ERROR') OR a."attr.http.response.status_code" >= 500),false),false) caller_error,
                    a.duration/1e6 caller_ms,
                    a.time <= p.time AND epoch_ns(a.time)::HUGEINT + a.duration >= epoch_ns(p.time)::HUGEINT + p.duration caller_contains
                  FROM pairs p LEFT JOIN caller_servers a ON a.trace_id=p.trace_id AND a.origin=p.span_id
                ) SELECT client_operation,server_operation,count(*) n,
                    list_sort(list_distinct(list(client_method))) client_methods,
                    list_sort(list_distinct(list(server_method))) server_methods,
                    median(client_ms) median_ms,quantile_cont(client_ms,.95) p95_ms,
                    median(server_ms) server_ms,median(wait_ms) wait_ms,
                    count(*) FILTER (WHERE client_error) errors,
                    count(*) FILTER (WHERE client_error AND caller_error AND caller_contains) linked_errors,
                    count(*) FILTER (WHERE caller_contains AND contained AND client_ms>=20 AND client_ms>=caller_ms*.5) dominant_calls,
                    count(*) FILTER (WHERE client_method<>server_method) method_mismatch,
                    min(time) first_time,max(time) last_time
                  FROM observed GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

WITH RECURSIVE ancestry AS (
                  SELECT p.trace_id,p.span_id origin,p.parent_span_id next_id,[p.span_id] visited
                  FROM abnormal_traces p WHERE p.service_name='ts-seat-service' AND lower(p."attr.span_kind") IN ('client', 'span_kind_client')
                  UNION ALL
                  SELECT x.trace_id,x.origin,a.parent_span_id,list_append(x.visited,a.span_id)
                  FROM ancestry x JOIN abnormal_traces a ON a.trace_id=x.trace_id AND a.span_id=x.next_id
                  WHERE a.service_name='ts-seat-service' AND NOT lower(a."attr.span_kind") IN ('server', 'span_kind_server')
                    AND NOT list_contains(x.visited,a.span_id)
                ), caller_servers AS (
                  SELECT x.origin,a.* FROM ancestry x JOIN abnormal_traces a
                    ON a.trace_id=x.trace_id AND a.span_id=x.next_id
                  WHERE a.service_name='ts-seat-service' AND lower(a."attr.span_kind") IN ('server', 'span_kind_server')
                ), pairs AS (
                  SELECT p.trace_id,p.span_id,p.parent_span_id,p.time,p.duration,
                    p.span_name client_operation,c.span_name server_operation,
                    p."attr.http.request.method" client_method,c."attr.http.request.method" server_method,
                    p.duration/1e6 client_ms,c.duration/1e6 server_ms,
                    (cast(p.duration AS DOUBLE)-cast(c.duration AS DOUBLE))/1e6 wait_ms,
                    coalesce((p."attr.status_code" IN ('Error','STATUS_CODE_ERROR') OR p."attr.http.response.status_code" >= 500),false) client_error,coalesce((c."attr.status_code" IN ('Error','STATUS_CODE_ERROR') OR c."attr.http.response.status_code" >= 500),false) server_error,
                    c.time >= p.time AND epoch_ns(c.time)::HUGEINT + c.duration <= epoch_ns(p.time)::HUGEINT + p.duration contained
                  FROM abnormal_traces p JOIN abnormal_traces c ON p.trace_id=c.trace_id AND p.span_id=c.parent_span_id
                  WHERE p.service_name='ts-seat-service' AND c.service_name='ts-order-other-service'
                    AND lower(p."attr.span_kind") IN ('client', 'span_kind_client') AND lower(c."attr.span_kind") IN ('server', 'span_kind_server')
                ), observed AS (
                  SELECT p.*,coalesce(coalesce((a."attr.status_code" IN ('Error','STATUS_CODE_ERROR') OR a."attr.http.response.status_code" >= 500),false),false) caller_error,
                    a.duration/1e6 caller_ms,
                    a.time <= p.time AND epoch_ns(a.time)::HUGEINT + a.duration >= epoch_ns(p.time)::HUGEINT + p.duration caller_contains
                  FROM pairs p LEFT JOIN caller_servers a ON a.trace_id=p.trace_id AND a.origin=p.span_id
                ) SELECT client_operation,server_operation,count(*) n,
                    list_sort(list_distinct(list(client_method))) client_methods,
                    list_sort(list_distinct(list(server_method))) server_methods,
                    median(client_ms) median_ms,quantile_cont(client_ms,.95) p95_ms,
                    median(server_ms) server_ms,median(wait_ms) wait_ms,
                    count(*) FILTER (WHERE client_error) errors,
                    count(*) FILTER (WHERE client_error AND caller_error AND caller_contains) linked_errors,
                    count(*) FILTER (WHERE caller_contains AND contained AND client_ms>=20 AND client_ms>=caller_ms*.5) dominant_calls,
                    count(*) FILTER (WHERE client_method<>server_method) method_mismatch,
                    min(time) first_time,max(time) last_time
                  FROM observed GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

WITH bindings AS (
                SELECT p.trace_id,p.span_id,p.parent_span_id,p.time,p.duration,p.span_name,
                  coalesce((p."attr.status_code" IN ('Error','STATUS_CODE_ERROR') OR p."attr.http.response.status_code" >= 500),false) is_error,
                  list_distinct(flatten(list(regexp_extract_all(l.message,'https?://([a-zA-Z0-9_-]+)(?:[.:/]|$)',1)))) hosts
                FROM normal_traces p JOIN normal_logs l ON l.trace_id=p.trace_id AND l.span_id=p.span_id
                  AND l.service_name=p.service_name AND l.time>=p.time
                  AND epoch_ns(l.time)::HUGEINT <= epoch_ns(p.time)::HUGEINT+p.duration
                WHERE p.service_name='ts-travel-service' AND lower(p."attr.span_kind") IN ('client', 'span_kind_client')
                  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM normal_traces c WHERE c.trace_id=p.trace_id AND c.parent_span_id=p.span_id AND lower(c."attr.span_kind") IN ('server', 'span_kind_server'))
                GROUP BY p.trace_id,p.span_id,p.parent_span_id,p.time,p.duration,p.span_name,p."attr.status_code",p."attr.http.response.status_code"
              ) SELECT b.span_name client_operation,count(*) n,count(*) FILTER (WHERE b.is_error) errors,
                  count(*) FILTER (WHERE b.is_error AND coalesce((a."attr.status_code" IN ('Error','STATUS_CODE_ERROR') OR a."attr.http.response.status_code" >= 500),false) AND a.time<=b.time
                    AND epoch_ns(a.time)::HUGEINT+a.duration >= epoch_ns(b.time)::HUGEINT+b.duration) linked_errors,
                  median(b.duration)/1e6 median_ms,min(b.time) first_time,max(b.time) last_time
                FROM bindings b LEFT JOIN normal_traces a ON a.trace_id=b.trace_id AND a.span_id=b.parent_span_id
                  AND a.service_name='ts-travel-service' AND lower(a."attr.span_kind") IN ('server', 'span_kind_server')
                WHERE len(b.hosts)=1 AND b.hosts[1]='ts-seat-service' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

sql:
SELECT service_name,count(*) n,
                  count(*) FILTER (WHERE regexp_matches(message,'(?i)\bexception\b|\berror\b|\bfailed\b|\bfailure\b')) events,
                  min(time) FILTER (WHERE regexp_matches(message,'(?i)\bexception\b|\berror\b|\bfailed\b|\bfailure\b')) first_event,
                  max(time) FILTER (WHERE regexp_matches(message,'(?i)\bexception\b|\berror\b|\bfailed\b|\bfailure\b')) last_event
                  FROM abnormal_logs WHERE service_name IN ('ts-order-other-service','ts-preserve-service','ts-seat-service','ts-security-service','ts-travel-plan-service','ts-travel-service','ts-travel2-service','ts-ui-dashboard') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

purpose: exact CLIENT/SERVER binding and nearest same-service caller SERVER ancestor
sql:
WITH RECURSIVE ancestry AS (
                  SELECT p.trace_id,p.span_id origin,p.parent_span_id next_id,[p.span_id] visited
                  FROM normal_traces p WHERE p.service_name='ts-ui-dashboard' AND lower(p."attr.span_kind") IN ('client', 'span_kind_client')
                  UNION ALL
                  SELECT x.trace_id,x.origin,a.parent_span_id,list_append(x.visited,a.span_id)
                  FROM ancestry x JOIN normal_traces a ON a.trace_id=x.trace_id AND a.span_id=x.next_id
                  WHERE a.service_name='ts-ui-dashboard' AND NOT lower(a."attr.span_kind") IN ('server', 'span_kind_server')
                    AND NOT list_contains(x.visited,a.span_id)
                ), caller_servers AS (
                  SELECT x.origin,a.* FROM ancestry x JOIN normal_traces a
                    ON a.trace_id=x.trace_id AND a.span_id=x.next_id
                  WHERE a.service_name='ts-ui-dashboard' AND lower(a."attr.span_kind") IN ('server', 'span_kind_server')
                ), pairs AS (
                  SELECT p.trace_id,p.span_id,p.parent_span_id,p.time,p.duration,
                    p.span_name client_operation,c.span_name server_operation,

WITH bindings AS (
                SELECT p.trace_id,p.span_id,p.parent_span_id,p.time,p.duration,p.span_name,
                  coalesce((p."attr.status_code" IN ('Error','STATUS_CODE_ERROR') OR p."attr.http.response.status_code" >= 500),false) is_error,
                  list_distinct(flatten(list(regexp_extract_all(l.message,'https?://([a-zA-Z0-9_-]+)(?:[.:/]|$)',1)))) hosts
                FROM normal_traces p JOIN normal_logs l ON l.trace_id=p.trace_id AND l.span_id=p.span_id
                  AND l.service_name=p.service_name AND l.time>=p.time
                  AND epoch_ns(l.time)::HUGEINT <= epoch_ns(p.time)::HUGEINT+p.duration
                WHERE p.service_name='ts-seat-service' AND lower(p."attr.span_kind") IN ('client', 'span_kind_client')
                  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM normal_traces c WHERE c.trace_id=p.trace_id AND c.parent_span_id=p.span_id AND lower(c."attr.span_kind") IN ('server', 'span_kind_server'))
                GROUP BY p.trace_id,p.span_id,p.parent_span_id,p.time,p.duration,p.span_name,p."attr.status_code",p."attr.http.response.status_code"
              ) SELECT b.span_name client_operation,count(*) n,count(*) FILTER (WHERE b.is_error) errors,
                  count(*) FILTER (WHERE b.is_error AND coalesce((a."attr.status_code" IN ('Error','STATUS_CODE_ERROR') OR a."attr.http.response.status_code" >= 500),false) AND a.time<=b.time
                    AND epoch_ns(a.time)::HUGEINT+a.duration >= epoch_ns(b.time)::HUGEINT+b.duration) linked_errors,
                  median(b.duration)/1e6 median_ms,min(b.time) first_time,max(b.time) last_time
                FROM bindings b LEFT JOIN normal_traces a ON a.trace_id=b.trace_id AND a.span_id=b.parent_span_id
                  AND a.service_name='ts-seat-service' AND lower(a."attr.span_kind") IN ('server', 'span_kind_server')
                WHERE len(b.hosts)=1 AND b.hosts[1]='ts-order-other-service' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

purpose: exact CLIENT/SERVER binding and nearest same-service caller SERVER ancestor
sql:
WITH RECURSIVE ancestry AS (
                  SELECT p.trace_id,p.span_id origin,p.parent_span_id next_id,[p.span_id] visited
                  FROM normal_traces p WHERE p.service_name='ts-ui-dashboard' AND lower(p."attr.span_kind") IN ('client', 'span_kind_client')
                  UNION ALL
                  SELECT x.trace_id,x.origin,a.parent_span_id,list_append(x.visited,a.span_id)
                  FROM ancestry x JOIN normal_traces a ON a.trace_id=x.trace_id AND a.span_id=x.next_id
                  WHERE a.service_name='ts-ui-dashboard' AND NOT lower(a."attr.span_kind") IN ('server', 'span_kind_server')
                    AND NOT list_contains(x.visited,a.span_id)
                ), caller_servers AS (
                  SELECT x.origin,a.* FROM ancestry x JOIN normal_traces a
                    ON a.trace_id=x.trace_id AND a.span_id=x.next_id
                  WHERE a.service_name='ts-ui-dashboard' AND lower(a."attr.span_kind") IN ('server', 'span_kind_server')
                ), pairs AS (
                  SELECT p.trace_id,p.span_id,p.parent_span_id,p.time,p.duration,
                    p.span_name client_operation,c.span_name server_operation,
                    p."attr.http.request.method" client_method,c."attr.http.request.method" server_method,
                    p.duration/1e6 client_ms,c.duration/1e6 server_ms,
                    (cast(p.duration AS DOUBLE)-cast(c.duration AS DOUBLE))/1e6 wait_ms,
                    coalesce((p."attr.status_code" IN ('Error','STATUS_CODE_ERROR') OR p."attr.http.response.status_code" >= 500),false) client_error,coalesce((c."attr.status_code" IN ('Error','STATUS_CODE_ERROR') OR c."attr.http.response.status_code" >= 500),false) server_error,
                    c.time >= p.time AND epoch_ns(c.time)::HUGEINT + c.duration <= epoch_ns(p.time)::HUGEINT + p.duration contained
                  FROM normal_traces p JOIN normal_traces c ON p.trace_id=c.trace_id AND p.span_id=c.parent_span_id
                  WHERE p.service_name='ts-ui-dashboard' AND c.service_name='ts-order-other-service'
                    AND lower(p."attr.span_kind") IN ('client', 'span_kind_client') AND lower(c."attr.span_kind") IN ('server', 'span_kind_server')
                ), observed AS (
                  SELECT p.*,coalesce(coalesce((a."attr.status_code" IN ('Error','STATUS_CODE_ERROR') OR a."attr.http.response.status_code" >= 500),false),false) caller_error,
                    a.duration/1e6 caller_ms,
                    a.time <= p.time AND epoch_ns(a.time)::HUGEINT + a.duration >= epoch_ns(p.time)::HUGEINT + p.duration caller_contains
                  FROM pairs p LEFT JOIN caller_servers a ON a.trace_id=p.trace_id AND a.origin=p.span_id
                ) SELECT client_operation,server_operation,count(*) n,
                    list_sort(list_distinct(list(client_method))) client_methods,
                    list_sort(list_distinct(list(server_method))) server_methods,
                    median(client_ms) median_ms,quantile_cont(client_ms,.95) p95_ms,
                    median(server_ms) server_ms,median(wait_ms) wait_ms,
                    count(*) FILTER (WHERE client_error) errors,
                    count(*) FILTER (WHERE client_error AND caller_error AND caller_contains) linked_errors,
                    count(*) FILTER (WHERE caller_contains AND contained AND client_ms>=20 AND client_ms>=caller_ms*.5) dominant_calls,
                    count(*) FILTER (WHERE client_method<>server_method) method_mismatch,
                    min(time) first_time,max(time) last_time
                  FROM observed GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2
SELECT count(*) n,min(time) first_time,max(time) last_time,epoch(max(time)-min(time)) observed_extent_seconds FROM abnormal_metrics

SELECT service_name,level,message AS "template",
                count(*) n,min(time) first_time,max(time) last_time FROM abnormal_logs
                WHERE service_name IN ('ts-order-other-service','ts-preserve-service','ts-seat-service','ts-security-service','ts-travel-plan-service','ts-travel-service','ts-travel2-service','ts-ui-dashboard') GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY 1,2,3

sql:
WITH bindings AS (
                SELECT p.trace_id,p.span_id,p.parent_span_id,p.time,p.duration,p.span_name,
                  coalesce((p."attr.status_code" IN ('Error','STATUS_CODE_ERROR') OR p."attr.http.response.status_code" >= 500),false) is_error,
                  list_distinct(flatten(list(regexp_extract_all(l.message,'https?://([a-zA-Z0-9_-]+)(?:[.:/]|$)',1)))) hosts
                FROM abnormal_traces p JOIN abnormal_logs l ON l.trace_id=p.trace_id AND l.span_id=p.span_id
                  AND l.service_name=p.service_name AND l.time>=p.time
                  AND epoch_ns(l.time)::HUGEINT <= epoch_ns(p.time)::HUGEINT+p.duration
                WHERE p.service_name='ts-travel-plan-service' AND lower(p."attr.span_kind") IN ('client', 'span_kind_client')
                  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM abnormal_traces c WHERE c.trace_id=p.trace_id AND c.parent_span_id=p.span_id AND lower(c."attr.span_kind") IN ('server', 'span_kind_server'))
                GROUP BY p.trace_id,p.span_id,p.parent_span_id,p.time,p.duration,p.span_name,p."attr.status_code",p."attr.http.response.status_code"
              ) SELECT b.span_name client_operation,count(*) n,count(*) FILTER (WHERE b.is_error) errors,
                  count(*) FILTER (WHERE b.is_error AND coalesce((a."attr.status_code" IN ('Error','STATUS_CODE_ERROR') OR a."attr.http.response.status_code" >= 500),false) AND a.time<=b.time
                    AND epoch_ns(a.time)::HUGEINT+a.duration >= epoch_ns(b.time)::HUGEINT+b.duration) linked_errors,
                  median(b.duration)/1e6 median_ms,min(b.time) first_time,max(b.time) last_time
                FROM bindings b LEFT JOIN abnormal_traces a ON a.trace_id=b.trace_id AND a.span_id=b.parent_span_id
                  AND a.service_name='ts-travel-plan-service' AND lower(a."attr.span_kind") IN ('server', 'span_kind_server')

sql:
WITH RECURSIVE ancestry AS (
                  SELECT p.trace_id,p.span_id origin,p.parent_span_id next_id,[p.span_id] visited
                  FROM normal_traces p WHERE p.service_name='ts-seat-service' AND lower(p."attr.span_kind") IN ('client', 'span_kind_client')
                  UNION ALL
                  SELECT x.trace_id,x.origin,a.parent_span_id,list_append(x.visited,a.span_id)
                  FROM ancestry x JOIN normal_traces a ON a.trace_id=x.trace_id AND a.span_id=x.next_id
                  WHERE a.service_name='ts-seat-service' AND NOT lower(a."attr.span_kind") IN ('server', 'span_kind_server')
                    AND NOT list_contains(x.visited,a.span_id)
                ), caller_servers AS (
                  SELECT x.origin,a.* FROM ancestry x JOIN normal_traces a
                    ON a.trace_id=x.trace_id AND a.span_id=x.next_id
                  WHERE a.service_name='ts-seat-service' AND lower(a."attr.span_kind") IN ('server', 'span_kind_server')
                ), pairs AS (
                  SELECT p.trace_id,p.span_id,p.parent_span_id,p.time,p.duration,
                    p.span_name client_operation,c.span_name server_operation,
                    p."attr.http.request.method" client_method,c."attr.http.request.method" server_method,
                    p.duration/1e6 client_ms,c.duration/1e6 server_ms,
                    (cast(p.duration AS DOUBLE)-cast(c.duration AS DOUBLE))/1e6 wait_ms,
                    coalesce((p."attr.status_code" IN ('Error','STATUS_CODE_ERROR') OR p."attr.http.response.status_code" >= 500),false) client_error,coalesce((c."attr.status_code" IN ('Error','STATUS_CODE_ERROR') OR c."attr.http.response.status_code" >= 500),false) server_error,
                    c.time >= p.time AND epoch_ns(c.time)::HUGEINT + c.duration <= epoch_ns(p.time)::HUGEINT + p.duration contained
                  FROM normal_traces p JOIN normal_traces c ON p.trace_id=c.trace_id AND p.span_id=c.parent_span_id
                  WHERE p.service_name='ts-seat-service' AND c.service_name='ts-order-other-service'
                    AND lower(p."attr.span_kind") IN ('client', 'span_kind_client') AND lower(c."attr.span_kind") IN ('server', 'span_kind_server')
                ), observed AS (
                  SELECT p.*,coalesce(coalesce((a."attr.status_code" IN ('Error','STATUS_CODE_ERROR') OR a."attr.http.response.status_code" >= 500),false),false) caller_error,
                    a.duration/1e6 caller_ms,
                    a.time <= p.time AND epoch_ns(a.time)::HUGEINT + a.duration >= epoch_ns(p.time)::HUGEINT + p.duration caller_contains
                  FROM pairs p LEFT JOIN caller_servers a ON a.trace_id=p.trace_id AND a.origin=p.span_id
                ) SELECT client_operation,server_operation,count(*) n,
                    list_sort(list_distinct(list(client_method))) client_methods,
                    list_sort(list_distinct(list(server_method))) server_methods,
                    median(client_ms) median_ms,quantile_cont(client_ms,.95) p95_ms,
                    median(server_ms) server_ms,median(wait_ms) wait_ms,
                    count(*) FILTER (WHERE client_error) errors,
                    count(*) FILTER (WHERE client_error AND caller_error AND caller_contains) linked_errors,
                    count(*) FILTER (WHERE caller_contains AND contained AND client_ms>=20 AND client_ms>=caller_ms*.5) dominant_calls,
                    count(*) FILTER (WHERE client_method<>server_method) method_mismatch,
                    min(time) first_time,max(time) last_time
                  FROM observed GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2
